messages:
Marco: quick flag  noticed spikes in unassigned inbound leads overnight; root cause looks like enrichment timeouts + RR allocation pause. want a short patch to keep handoffs under SLA.
Anya: what SLA threshold are we targeting? 20s? 30s?
Marco: target 20s for assignment to any pool. if enrich not done by 18s, assign to inbound-temp-rr so queueing continues and our SLO holds.
Sam: inbound-temp-rr is fine. please include a contact property so SDRs know why they got it.
Devon: important: when enrichment completes later, we should not overwrite owner unless the new owner is higher priority. otherwise we get churn.
Lina: propose webhook patch: 1) try enrich with 1 retry (+300ms), 2) start 18s timer, 3) on timer hit assign to inbound-temp-rr and set property 'assignment_fallback:webhook-18s', 4) emit metric lead.assignment.fallback.
Anya: SF sync rule: only update SF owner if sfdc_owner is empty OR overwrite_owner=true. add a label so sync ignores fallback owners by default.
SyncBot: test event logged: contact.5501 enrichment=delayed -> assigned=inbound-temp-rr (sim)
Sam: I'll update SDR play note and create a short pinned message describing the behavior.
Marco: action items: Lina push patch to staging (Lina), Anya update SF sync (Anya), Devon run a 100-lead canary tomorrow 09:30PT (Devon), Sam prep comms for SDRs (Sam). plan to promote Monday if canary clean.
Devon: will measure fallback rate and owner-churn. will tag this thread with results.
Lina: patch pushed to staging (PR: https://git.redwood/infra/1350). endpoint: https://staging.hub-webhook.redwood/assign-fallback. ready for canary.
Marco: thanks — keep the fallback window configurable (env var) so we can tweak during peak windows.
Anya: added Datadog tile and monitor: alert if fallback_rate > 2% sustained for 10m.
Sam: one-liner for SDRs: "If enrichment delays, leads auto-assign to a temporary inbound RR pool after ~18s; contact note shows fallback reason. SF owner won\u2019t change unless explicitly forced."
Marco: perfect, closing loop Monday stand. :rocket:
